title: Tibs
intro: Tibs is an Ethiopian dish of sautéed meat, most often beef or lamb, cooked quickly with onions, garlic and chillies and seasoned with Ethiopia's signature berbere spice blend. It's a staple of Ethiopian home cooking and restaurant menus alike, valued for its deep, warmly spiced flavour and the way it's traditionally scooped up with injera flatbread instead of cutlery.
